_editing_note: What the chamber does, in four strands. Each `item` gets a card. `pictogram` names a drawing in components/pictograms — the available names are listed in CONTENT-GUIDE.md.
intro: Four kinds of work, done for 750+ member organisations across eight districts.

strands.title: Represent
strands.lede: Taking industry's case to the people who decide.
strands.photoAlt: Shri Suresh Prabhu addressing CMIA members at a CXO roundtable

items.title: Issues taken up with government
items.detail: The chamber supports members in representing a specific issue with local administration, the state government or the centre.

items.title: Cordial standing with administration
items.detail: Long-standing relationships with local administration and the state and central governments let the chamber take an issue to the right authority for an amicable solution.

items.title: Government notifications, circulated monthly
items.detail: Copies of important notifications related to industry go to the concerned member every month.

strands.title: Facilitate
strands.lede: Clearing the path for a unit that wants to start, or grow.
strands.photoAlt: Officials signing the memorandum of understanding between the Government of Maharashtra and Toyota Kirloskar Motors, with CMIA present

items.title: Certificate of Origin
items.detail: CMIA is authorised to issue Certificates of Origin to exporters from the region.

items.title: GSP issuance, without the trip to Mumbai
items.detail: A fortnightly visit by an Export Inspection Council representative from Mumbai, so GSP can be issued here.

items.title: A help desk for tax questions
items.detail: Available at the secretariat for issues related to service tax.

items.title: From first enquiry to expansion
items.detail: A facilitating agency for new investors exploring the region, and for existing units expanding.
more: A catalyst in resolving legitimate issues with any government, semi-government or private agency.

strands.title: Promote
strands.lede: Putting Marathwada's products in front of buyers.
strands.photoAlt: A long registration queue at the CMIA lighting and rooftop solar conclave

items.title: Maha Expo, once every four years
items.detail: A high-profile exhibition putting Marathwada in front of investors, with exhibitors from across the country and visitors from abroad.
more: Concurrent seminars bring eminent international speakers for keynotes on current topics.
Cultural and entertainment programmes run alongside, drawing tourists to the region.

items.title: Buyer-seller meets and business visits
items.detail: Along with themed seminars and training programmes hosted for local industry and students.

items.title: Export promotion
items.detail: Special efforts to promote member industries and their products in export markets.

strands.title: Build
strands.lede: The next generation of skills, and the facilities to teach them.
strands.photoAlt: A Marathwada Skill Hub meeting in progress at CMIA

items.title: Industry-academia interaction
items.detail: A dedicated cell keeps industry and academic institutions talking on a regular basis.

items.title: Training programmes as members need them
items.detail: Organised for the benefit of members according to need.

items.title: Seven cluster projects
items.detail: Common Facility Centres putting shared machinery, testing and training within reach of micro and small units.
